Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1975
ACT I OF 1975
PEOPLE'S FINANCE
CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act to amend
the People's Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.----This Act may be called the People's Finance Corporation
(Amendment) Act, 1974.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 1, Act XXIX of 1972

ACT I OF 1975
PEOPLE'S FINANCE
CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1974
An Act to amend
the People's Finance Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 17th January 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 13th January 1975, and is hereby
published for general information :-
2. Amendment of section 1, Act
XXIX of 1972.----In the People's Finance Corporation Act, 1972 (XXIX of
1972), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 1, in subsection
(2), after the word "Pakistan" at the end, the words "and also
applies to the business of Corporation transacted outside Pakistan and the
persons conducting such business" shall be added.

Amendment of section 18, Act XXIX of 1972

The following Act of Parliament

published for general information :-
3. Amendment of section 18,
Act XXIX of 1972.----In the said Act, in section 18, for subsection (1) the
following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(1) Individuals and firms,
having net assets not exceeding fifty thousand rupees in value, and all classes
of small business owned or sponsored by such individuals or firms, shall be
eligible for loans from the Corporation for such purposes, to such extent and
subject to such conditions as may be prescribed."
